functions.name: validate_email
functions.docstring:
Validate email address format.

Args:
    email: Email address to validate
    
Returns:
    True if email is valid, False otherwise

functions.name: validate_url
functions.docstring:
Validate URL format.

Args:
    url: URL to validate
    
Returns:
    True if URL is valid, False otherwise

functions.name: sanitize_filename
functions.docstring:
Sanitize filename by removing invalid characters.

Args:
    filename: Original filename
    max_length: Maximum allowed length
    
Returns:
    Sanitized filename

functions.name: validate_slug
functions.docstring:
Validate URL-safe slug format.

Args:
    slug: Slug to validate
    
Returns:
    True if slug is valid, False otherwise

functions.name: validate_version
functions.docstring:
Validate semantic version format (x.y.z).

Args:
    version: Version string to validate
    
Returns:
    True if version is valid semver, False otherwise

functions.name: validate_hex_color
functions.docstring:
Validate hexadecimal color code.

Args:
    color: Color code to validate
    
Returns:
    True if color is valid hex, False otherwise
